name: Kurogane
title: The Neon Bastion
description: An armored cyberpunk command robot whose four remote weapon funnels project an interlocked shield.
biography: Kurogane guards the power conduits of a deserted neon transit yard. Its remote funnels once guided freight through the city; a corrupted siege directive has turned their navigation lattice into a shield and crossfire grid. Break the four independent relays to expose the main body.
origin: The Neon Switchyard, an original fictional PawTrail location
motivation: Enforce the abandoned yard’s corrupted perimeter directive.

reference.mechanic: Owner requested remote weapon funnels like a mecha anime; original robot armor and artwork, no copied franchise model.
reference.art: Generated original charcoal/ivory cyberpunk armor with cyan emitters and magenta reactor.

components.required: All four must be destroyed before main-body HP can decrease.
components.reset: All four and their HP return only on encounter reset.
components.targetShape: 1.24 by 1.24 world-unit square hurtboxes at live funnel positions.

weaknesses: Destroy independent funnels A–D to disable the body shield.
With the shield down, recovery hits deal ×1.5 damage.

sounds.shared: Existing confirmed contact/item audio and mute.

review: Firefox 2026-11-12: body shield blocked real hits with four and one funnels alive; all four destroyed by sword/wave; body then accepted 270 HP (8400 to 8130); reset restored four 360-HP funnels, shield and full HP. Enrage rehearsal, five-disk dodge and all three normal attacks observed. Full boss defeat/natural threshold crossing unreviewed. See docs/implementation/kurogane-neon-bastion.md.
